visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair is wearing a yellow and blue color-blocked top and white shorts while sitting on a bright yellow sofa. She holds a black smartphone for a selfie before a hand enters the frame from the right to hand her a Tokyo travel guidebook. She looks annoyed, squinting her eyes and pouting her mouth, before tossing the book aside onto the sofa. (2) She looks directly into the camera lens, speaking with high facial animation and using her right hand to gesture toward the screen. The background is a white brick wall with warm, soft lighting. (4) The woman returns to the frame, holding her phone and pointing at the screen with an excited expression. She then shows various menu options on the phone, including different AI models and reasoning modes. (5) The setting shifts to a busy office workplace with multiple computer monitors and desks. The woman excitedly grabs a green jacket and a beige bag, slinging them over her shoulder. As she turns to run away, she accidentally bumps into a male colleague who is sitting at his desk wearing large black headphones.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the Perplexity AI app and its collaboration with the Taiwan Mobile carrier. It uses a relatable scenario (planning a trip) to demonstrate the AI's efficiency over traditional guidebooks and concludes with a specific limited-time free subscription offer for carrier users.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the Perplexity app, verbal recommendation, and explicit mention of the Taiwan Mobile partnership and promotional details.
